```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)

# Load survey data
df <- read_csv("data/ai_cognitive_dependence.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

scale_map <- c(
  "Strongly Disagree" = 1,
  "Disagree" = 2,
  "Neutral" = 3,
  "Agree" = 4,
  "Strongly Agree" = 5
)

# Extract column names
cols <- names(df)
```

::: {.hero-banner}
# Neural Atlas of AI Cognitive Dependence
Explore how university students' reliance on generative AI maps onto core cognitive brain networks. Based on empirical survey responses from **`r format(nrow(df), big.mark = ",")` students**, this interactive atlas connects behavioral patterns to functional neuroanatomy.

::: {.callout-important}
### 🧠 Executive Summary: Does AI Reduce Critical Thinking in Teens?
**Yes, the data indicates strong cognitive reduction.** Among teens and younger undergraduates (n = 781, age ≤ 20):

- **77.8%** report they analyze less when using AI responses.
- **76.8%** rely more on AI-generated ideas than their own thinking.
- **76.3%** acknowledge AI reduces their independent problem-solving efforts.
- **75.0%** explicitly state AI reduces their need to think deeply.

*Takeaway:* Generative AI acts as a "cognitive crutch" — providing instant answers that short-circuit prefrontal cognitive friction and reduce active analytical reasoning.
:::

## Cross-System Comparison

How do the 5 neural systems compare across all 2,613 respondents? The chart below contrasts mean scores and agreement ratios.

```{r}
#| label: region-comparison-plot
#| fig-height: 5

regions_summary <- tibble(
  Region = c("Parietal Cortex", "Hippocampus", "Prefrontal Cortex", "Anterior Cingulate", "Nucleus Accumbens"),
  Cognitive_Domain = c("AI Usage", "Academic Decisions", "Critical Thinking", "Trust & Verification", "Cognitive Dependence"),
  Prefix = c("AI Usage", "Academic Decision-Making", "Critical Thinking", "Trust in AI", "Cognitive Dependence"),
  Color = c("#0ea5e9", "#10b981", "#8b5cf6", "#f43f5e", "#f59e0b")
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    q_cols = list(cols[str_starts(cols, fixed(Prefix))]),
    matrix_vals = list(as.matrix(mutate(select(df, all_of(q_cols)), across(everything(), \(x) scale_map[x])))),
    mean_score = round(mean(rowMeans(matrix_vals, na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
    pct_agree = round(100 * mean(rowMeans(matrix_vals, na.rm = TRUE) >= 3.5), 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(mean_score)

p <- plot_ly(
  data = regions_summary,
  x = ~mean_score,
  y = ~reorder(Region, mean_score),
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  marker = list(
    color = ~Color,
    line = list(color = "#1e293b", width = 1)
  ),
  text = ~paste0(mean_score, " / 5 (", pct_agree, "% high)"),
  textposition = "outside",
  hoverinfo = "text",
  hovertext = ~paste0(
    "<b>", Region, "</b><br>",
    "Cognitive Domain: ", Cognitive_Domain, "<br>",
    "Mean Score: ", mean_score, " / 5<br>",
    "Students with High Dependence: ", pct_agree, "%"
  )
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Mean Likert Score (1: Strongly Disagree, 5: Strongly Agree)",
      range = c(1, 5.3),
      tickvals = 1:5,
      ticktext = c("1 - Str. Disagree", "2 - Disagree", "3 - Neutral", "4 - Agree", "5 - Str. Agree"),
      color = "#cbd5e1",
      gridcolor = "#1f2937"
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "", color = "#cbd5e1"),
    margin = list(l = 150, r = 50, t = 30, b = 50),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font = list(family = "-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto", size = 12, color = "#cbd5e1")
  )

p
```

::: {.callout-note}
### Key Finding from the Data
Every single brain system averages above **3.50 out of 5.0**, showing widespread behavioral and cognitive integration of AI across Bangladeshi university students. The highest domain is **Parietal Cortex (AI Usage)** at **3.80**, followed by **Prefrontal Cortex (Critical Thinking reduction)** at **3.75**.
:::

## Neural Scan Cloud: 2,613 Individual Respondent Scans

Hover over any dot among the **2,613 student data points** below to inspect their individual survey scan, discipline, and scores across the 5 neural circuits.

```{r}
#| label: scans-scatter-plot
#| fig-height: 6

pfc_cols <- cols[str_starts(cols, "Critical Thinking")]
nac_cols <- cols[str_starts(cols, "Cognitive Dependence")]
hippo_cols <- cols[str_starts(cols, "Academic Decision-Making")]
acc_cols <- cols[str_starts(cols, "Trust in AI")]
parietal_cols <- cols[str_starts(cols, "AI Usage")]

set.seed(42)

df_scans <- df |>
  mutate(across(c(all_of(pfc_cols), all_of(nac_cols), all_of(hippo_cols), all_of(acc_cols), all_of(parietal_cols)), \(x) scale_map[x])) |>
  mutate(
    scan_id = paste0("Scan #", row_number()),
    pfc = round(rowMeans(across(all_of(pfc_cols)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    nac = round(rowMeans(across(all_of(nac_cols)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    hippo = round(rowMeans(across(all_of(hippo_cols)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    acc = round(rowMeans(across(all_of(acc_cols)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    parietal = round(rowMeans(across(all_of(parietal_cols)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    # Subtle jitter to separate overlapping integer Likert averages
    pfc_jitter = round(pfc + runif(n(), -0.05, 0.05), 3),
    nac_jitter = round(nac + runif(n(), -0.05, 0.05), 3),
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<b>", scan_id, "</b> • ", `Department/Discipline`, "<br>",
      "<b>Level:</b> ", `Academic Level`, " (", Gender, ", Age ", Age, ")<br>",
      "<b>University:</b> ", `University Type`, "<br>",
      "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━<br>",
      "🧠 <b>Prefrontal (Critical Thinking):</b> ", pfc, " / 5<br>",
      "⚡ <b>Nucleus Accumbens (Dependence):</b> ", nac, " / 5<br>",
      "🌱 <b>Hippocampus (Study Planning):</b> ", hippo, " / 5<br>",
      "🔍 <b>ACC (Verification/Trust):</b> ", acc, " / 5<br>",
      "🛠️ <b>Parietal (Task Execution):</b> ", parietal, " / 5"
    )
  )

p_scatter <- plot_ly(
  data = df_scans,
  x = ~pfc_jitter,
  y = ~nac_jitter,
  color = ~`Academic Level`,
  colors = c("Undergraduate" = "#a78bfa", "Postgraduate" = "#38bdf8"),
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(
    size = 6.5,
    opacity = 0.68,
    line = list(width = 0.5, color = "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)")
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  text = ~hover_label
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>2,613 Individual Student Scans: Executive Function vs. Cognitive Dependence</b>",
      font = list(color = "#f8fafc", size = 15)
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Prefrontal Cortex Score (Reduced Critical Thinking)",
      color = "#cbd5e1",
      gridcolor = "#1f2937",
      zerolinecolor = "#334155",
      range = c(0.8, 5.2)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Nucleus Accumbens Score (Cognitive Dependence & Habituation)",
      color = "#cbd5e1",
      gridcolor = "#1f2937",
      zerolinecolor = "#334155",
      range = c(0.8, 5.2)
    ),
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "<b>Academic Level</b>", font = list(color = "#f8fafc")),
      font = list(color = "#cbd5e1"),
      bgcolor = "rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.8)",
      bordercolor = "#334155",
      borderwidth = 1
    ),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "#0b0f19",
    font = list(family = "-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto", color = "#cbd5e1")
  )

p_scatter
```

## Demographics & Sample Breakdown

The study surveyed **`r nrow(df)` university students** across academic levels, institutional models, and degree disciplines.

```{r}
#| label: demographics-plots
#| fig-height: 4

acad_df <- df |>
  count(`Academic Level`, name = "count") |>
  mutate(pct = round(count / sum(count) * 100, 1))

p_demog <- plot_ly(
  data = acad_df,
  labels = ~`Academic Level`,
  values = ~count,
  type = "pie",
  hole = 0.5,
  marker = list(colors = c("#a78bfa", "#38bdf8")),
  textinfo = "label+percent",
  hoverinfo = "label+value+percent"
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Distribution by Academic Level", font = list(size = 14, color = "#f8fafc")),
    showlegend = TRUE,
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    legend = list(font = list(color = "#cbd5e1")),
    font = list(color = "#cbd5e1"),
    margin = list(t = 40, b = 20, l = 20, r = 20)
  )

p_demog
```
